definitions.explanation: A box or case for storing and carrying hand tools.

examples.japanese: {工具箱|こうぐばこ}からドライバーを{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I took a screwdriver out of the toolbox.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}の{工具箱|こうぐばこ}には{色々|いろいろ}な{道具|どうぐ}が{入|はい}っている。
examples.english: My father's toolbox holds all sorts of tools.

examples.japanese: {作業|さぎょう}が{終|お}わったら、{工具|こうぐ}を{工具箱|こうぐばこ}に{片付|かたづ}けてください。
examples.english: When you finish the work, please put the tools away in the toolbox.

notes:
Composed of {工具|こうぐ} (tools) + {箱|はこ} (box; read ばこ here through rendaku).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {工具箱|こうぐばこ}を{開|あ}ける: to open a toolbox
- {工具箱|こうぐばこ}に{片付|かたづ}ける: to put away in a toolbox

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {道具箱|どうぐばこ}: tool box — broader, for any implements, not only mechanical tools
